episodes.title: Element 1
episodes.summary: Paleontologist Helena Walker awakens on an island full of strange beasts.

episodes.title: Element 2
episodes.summary: Helena's on the run from Nerva's scouts, when she meets a new ally: Meiyin.

episodes.title: Element 3
episodes.summary: Helena makes allies in a treetop village, and travels to a Pteranodon den.

episodes.title: Element 4
episodes.summary: Helena and her friends devise a daring plan to liberate prisoners.

episodes.title: Element 5
episodes.summary: Nerva unleashes a punishing surprise-attack against John's village.

episodes.title: Element 6
episodes.summary: Helena, John and Henry risk everything to rescue Meiyin from Nerva.
